name: Spectrum Filaments (Spectrum Group Sp. z o.o.)
summary: Polish filament manufacturer near Warsaw that debuted in 2015 and now lists 50+ materials, from commodity PLA and PET-G through PCTG, PA, PP, PC, PPS, PEBA and soluble supports, plus pellets and a spool refill system. States that all filament is produced in-house in Poland, and is expanding into North America with a dedicated US warehouse and store.

additional_notes: Registered address: Spectrum Group Sp. z o.o., Parkowa 85, 05-806 Pecice, Poland; production is at the same Pecice site near Warsaw. Also operates a legacy shop at https://shop.spectrumfilaments.com/ and an alternate Shopify storefront at https://spectrum-filaments.myshopify.com/, neither of which is recorded in endpoints since the current US store supersedes them. Offers spool authenticity verification. Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and TikTok all reportedly use the handle @spectrumfilaments, but the exact URLs were not individually confirmed, so only LinkedIn is recorded. No build-plate products found. Price tier recorded as premium for the Premium PLA/engineering range although the catalogue straddles mid and premium; no verified $/kg figure.

provenance.conflicts: Price tier is a judgment call: the catalogue spans budget-adjacent 'The Filament' value products through premium engineering grades, and no verified per-kg pricing was found. 'The Filament' and 'PrograFen' are recorded as portfolio brands rather than separate entries because no independent catalogue or web presence was found for either; if either turns out to have its own storefront it should be split out.
